## A reproducible Python figure

The example uses fixed input values and an explicit plotting seed so
repeated renders produce the same analytical result.

``` python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
y = [1, 2, 2, 4, 5]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.plot(x, y, marker="o", color="#31688e", linewidth=2)
ax.set(xlabel="Observation", ylabel="Value")
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
plt.show()
```
